def rule6(g,bg):
    ci=comps4(g,bg); cnt=defaultdict(int)
    for col,cells in ci: cnt[col]+=1
    dd=defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in ci: dd[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))

    if not cl: return None
    single=[(c2,cs2) for c2,cs2 in ci if cnt[c2]==1]
    tg=max(single,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))

    cl.sort(key=lambda l:(-len(l[0][1]), -edist(center(far(l)[1]),tc)))
    m=far(cl[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r2,c2 in m[1]: out[r2][c2]=tg[0]

def comps8(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cs=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); cs.append((y,x))
                    for dy in (-1,0,1):
                        for dx in (-1,0,1):
                            if dy==0 and dx==0: continue
                            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and g[yy][xx]==col and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                                seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
                out.append((col,cs))
    return out
def analyze5(g,bg,conn):
    ci=comps8(g,bg) if conn==8 else comps4(g,bg)
    cnt=defaultdict(int)
    for col,cells in ci: cnt[col]+=1
    dd=defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in ci: dd[normf(cells)].append((col,cells))
    cls=[(k2,list(l)) for k2,l in dd.items() if len(l)>1]
    single=[(c2,cs2) for c2,cs2 in ci if cnt[c2]==1]
    return ci,cnt,cls,single
def run_rule2(g,bg,conn,classfn,memberfn):
    ci,cnt,cls,single=analyze5(g,bg,conn)
    if not cls: return None
    tg=max(single,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))
    tc=(sum(p[0] for p in tg[1])/len(tg[1]), sum(p[1] for p in tg[1])/len(tg[1]))
    scored=[]
    for n,l in cls:
        euc=[math.hypot((sum(p[0] for p in cs)/len(cs))-tc[0],(sum(p[1] for p in cs)/len(cs))-tc[1]) for c2,cs in l]
        man=[min(abs(a-c)+abs(b-d) for a,b in cs for c,d in tg[1]) for c2,cs in l]
        scored.append((classfn(n,l,euc,man,tg),l,euc,man))
    best=max(scored,key=lambda x:x[0])
    l,euc,man=best[1],best[2],best[3]
    i={'eucmax':max(range(len(l)),key=lambda j:euc[j]),'manmax':max(range(len(l)),key=lambda j:man[j]),
       'eucmin':min(range(len(l)),key=lambda j:euc[j]),'manmin':min(range(len(l)),key=lambda j:man[j])}[memberfn]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in l[i][1]: out[r][c]=tg[0]
    return out,l[i]
def dims(cells):
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    return max(rs)-min(rs)+1, max(cs)-min(cs)+1

    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]

    best=None
    for f in (lambda p:p, lambda p:(p[1],p[0]), lambda p:(-p[0],p[1]), lambda p:(p[0],-p[1]),

        h=max(x[0] for x in pts); w=max(x[1] for x in pts)
        q=tuple(sorted((min(f((r,c)))[0],0) for r,c in pts))  # placeholder
    # simpler: generate variants
    variants=[]

        for rot in range(4):
            q=[(r,c) for r,c in pts]

            if flip: q=[(r,-c) for r,c in q]
            rr=[x[0] for x in q]; cc=[x[1] for x in q]
            mr,mc=min(rr),min(cc)

        eucs=[math.hypot(sum(p[0] for p in cs)/len(cs)-tc[0], sum(p[1] for p in cs)/len(cs)-tc[1]) for c2,cs in l]
        return max(range(len(l)),key=lambda j:eucs[j])
    def far(l):
        eucs=[math.hypot(sum(p[0] for p in cs)/len(cs)-tc[0], sum(p[1] for p in cs)/len(cs)-tc[1]) for c2,cs in l]

def run(f,**kw):
    okall=True; res={}
    for k,b in ALL:
        out,mm=f(G[k+' input'],b,**kw)
        res[k]=out==G[k+' output']
        if not res[k]: okall=False
    line=f.__name__+' '+str(kw)+' all:'+str(okall)
    if okall:
        out,mm=f(T,6,**kw); line+=' TEST:'+str(mm)
    print(line); return okall

# same-color pref + largest + farthest, with correct target
def rule_same3(g,bg,dih=False):
    ci=comps4(g,bg); dd=defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in ci: dd[dihedral_norm(cells) if dih else normf(cells)].append((col,cells))
    cls=[(k2,l) for k2,l in dd.items() if len(l)>1]
    tg,_=pick_target2(g,bg)
    tc=(sum(p[0] for p in tg[1])/len(tg[1]), sum(p[1] for p in tg[1])/len(tg[1]))
    def euc(cs):
        cc=(sum(p[0] for p in cs)/len(cs), sum(p[1] for p in cs)/len(cs))
        return math.hypot(cc[0]-tc[0],cc[1]-tc[1])
    same=[(k2,l) for k2,l in cls if len({c2 for c2,cs in l})==1]
    pool=same or cls
    k2,l=max(pool,key=lambda x:(len(x[1][0][1]), max(euc(cs) for c2,cs in x[1])))
    es=[euc(cs) for c2,cs in l]; i=max(range(len(l)),key=lambda j:es[j])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in l[i][1]: out[r][c]=tg[0]
    return out,l[i]
run(rule_same3); run(rule_same3,dih=True)
